status: frozen before any held-out run, from dev results only (stage 3 and the stage 6 dev pilot)
quality_target: each player's best-response gain <= min(1% of the root pot, 0.1 BB), in the declared capped, projected search game
control_rule: the first control_count / 2 roots of each held-out panel, in panel order
gate_reading: quality and belief gates apply to every evaluated held-out decision or control; coverage needs at least 90% of eligible held-out decisions; latency needs median <= 0.5 s and p95 <= 2 s
reference_rule: a reference qualifies when each player's gain in the exact-joint game is at most reference_tolerance_bb within reference_checkpoints; an unqualified reference makes that control, and the belief verdict, inconclusive

dev_pilot.budget_reason: two dev references missed 0.01 BB at 4096 sweeps (0.011 and 0.032 BB, in 44.5 and 108 BB pots)
